svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two plates 160 x 1050 x 5, set 290 apart (centres), front and rear.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In both plates: a 50 hole 150 up from the bottom edge (jackshaft) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 38 hole 950 up (crank shaft), both on the centre line. Drill as a pair.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear plate only: 12 hole for the pawl pin, 70 right of and 75 above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld 1.5 mm side sheets on both long edges and a bottom sheet, so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: box is closed round the chain; weld a 6 mm top plate on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend 40 mm tabs at the foot of each plate for 2 x M8 into the rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Braces: 30 x 30 x 2 SHS from 830 up the tower side to the mid rail

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends; cut the ends to sit flat; bolt M8 both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 40 bar passes through both 50 holes square to the plates.
